comment: Given/when/then regression scenarios for the gameplay policies (src/game/policies). Each case feeds explicit inputs to a pure policy function and asserts the decision. These are the most expensive bugs to regress (unfair death, bad eat-claim accept/reject) so they get named, language-neutral fixtures. Run by tests/policy_scenarios.rs. 'expect' is the decision: for enemy_contact one of NoContact|TrackContact|KillPlayer; for enemy_death one of NoServerContact|Track|DelayVisibleGap|DelayNoVisibleHistory|Kill; for the eat policies either 'ok' or the exact reject reason string.

scenarios.name: observe_only_kills_despite_visible_gap
scenarios.comment: Observe-only (visible_confirm_radius_px=null): the enemy overlaps on the server (0.5px) but the victim's client rendered it 32px away. The reconstructed gap is logged but does NOT block the honest server kill.

scenarios.name: armed_gate_defers_unfair_death_candidate
scenarios.comment: Server confirms but the victim's reconstructed visible distance (30px) exceeds the visible-confirm RADIUS (20px = 18px sprite overlap + 2px grace, NOT the 11px kill radius): the player hasn't seen contact, so the death is HELD.

scenarios.name: armed_gate_holds_forever_without_timer
scenarios.comment: NO liveness/timer kill: even after a long contact run (53 ticks), while the reconstructed visible distance stays beyond the confirm radius the kill is still HELD. server_tick - interp_delay never catches server_tick, so a timeout-kill would always fire against a gap.

scenarios.name: armed_gate_kills_when_visible_confirms
scenarios.comment: Server confirms AND the reconstructed visible distance (18px, sprites just overlapping) is within the confirm radius (20px): the player saw contact, so the kill fires.

scenarios.name: v4_projected_gap_holds_confirmed_ghost
scenarios.comment: policy v4 / device ghost (room 1ebe, tick 1635): the enemy-reconstructed leg confirms (16.99 <= 18) but the victim, projected forward by its client lead, is BEYOND the radius (20.35 > 18) — the client drew the kill at 21px. The projected leg HOLDS it (delay_visible_gap) where the reconstructed-only rule would have killed.

scenarios.name: v4_both_legs_confirm_kills
scenarios.comment: policy v4 / honest device death (tick 716): both legs within the radius — reconstructed 16.4 and projected 8.3 (the victim moved INTO the enemy) — so the kill fires.

scenarios.name: v4_projected_missing_falls_back_to_reconstructed_only
scenarios.comment: policy v4 fallback: no client lead sample (projected null) — the gate must NOT regress to a ghost-prone kill on the bare reconstructed value beyond the radius; reconstructed 30 > 18 holds. (The Room logs projected_visible_missing_on_death_candidate.)

scenarios.name: v5_prediction_uncertain_holds_turn_boundary_ghost
scenarios.comment: policy v5 / device ghost (room c5126, tick 1236): both legs nominally confirm (reconstructed 15.81, projected 9.72, radius 18) but the kill leans HARD on the projection (help 6.09) at a turn-sensitive lead (4). The constant-velocity projection went stale at a turn (server projected the victim right while the client drew it going down → 20.1px on screen). HOLD instead of killing.

scenarios.name: v5_close_contact_kills_despite_lead
scenarios.comment: policy v5 guard is OFF when the contact is genuinely close (raw 13.4 <= 14.5) even at a big lead (6) — the projection isn't the deciding factor, so the kill is trustworthy.

scenarios.name: armed_gate_without_history_holds_not_server_kills
scenarios.comment: Gate armed but no history to reconstruct (null visible dist) — e.g. early match / generation mismatch. The player-visible timeline is AUTHORITATIVE, so the kill is HELD (delay_no_visible_history), NOT a server-current kill. Early-match non-lethality is covered by spawn protection, not a server-only kill. (lead review round 3)

scenarios.name: below_server_threshold_tracks_candidate
scenarios.comment: Server-timeline contact run still building (1/3): Track regardless of the visible overlap — the gate only ever delays a confirmed kill, never adds one.

scenarios.name: unfair_death_no_kill_one_tick_brush
scenarios.comment: Render-skewed enemy momentarily inside the shrunk radius but only for one tick: must NOT kill (the contact-ticks gate is the whole anti-unfair-death mechanism).

scenarios.name: enemy_contact_kills_after_threshold
scenarios.comment: Same enemy held in range for the required run: a real pass-through dies.

scenarios.name: enemy_contact_out_of_range_no_kill
scenarios.comment: Centres within the raw collision distance but outside the victim-favored shrunk radius: no contact.

scenarios.name: enemy_contact_shielded_never_kills
scenarios.comment: Spawn-protected / safe-zone player overlapping an enemy past the threshold: still no kill.

scenarios.name: eat_claim_accept_enemy
scenarios.comment: Heavier attacker, enemy long-lived, overlap reconstructs within radius+slack: accept.

scenarios.name: eat_claim_reject_stale_generation
scenarios.comment: Reusable-entity guard: client named generation 2 but the live enemy is on generation 3 (it respawned, id reused). Rejected before any tick heuristic — a stale claim against a dead life.

scenarios.name: eat_claim_accept_matching_generation
scenarios.comment: Client named the live generation (3 == 3): the explicit guard passes and the otherwise-valid claim is accepted.

scenarios.name: eat_claim_reject_enemy_respawn_grace
scenarios.comment: Targeted frame falls inside the just-respawned grace window: reject (double-eat guard).

scenarios.name: eat_claim_reject_cannot_eat_lighter_enemy
scenarios.comment: Attacker not invincible and not strictly heavier: cannot eat.

scenarios.name: eat_claim_reject_reconstruct_no_overlap
scenarios.comment: Server cannot reconstruct the overlap the client claimed (beyond radius+slack): reject.

scenarios.name: eat_claim_accept_player
scenarios.comment: Victim available now and at the target tick, both out of safe zone, attacker heavier, overlap reconstructs: accept.

scenarios.name: eat_claim_reject_player_safe_zone
scenarios.comment: Either party in a safe zone: PvP eat rejected.

scenarios.name: eat_claim_reject_skew
scenarios.comment: Attacker render tick too far ahead of the target render tick (>30): view-skew abuse rejected.

scenarios.name: eat_claim_shape_ok
scenarios.comment: Well-formed claim within the skew window passes shape validation.
